description: Unit test script that verifies the functionality of retrieving execution commands for various project types within the universalinit package. It uses pytest to parametrize multiple project scenarios, mocking the necessary components, and checks if the correct command strings are generated and output as JSON.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: Class representing configuration info for initializing templates, including the command to run the project.

classes.name: RunTool
classes.description: Class encapsulating the command and working directory for running a project.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Class responsible for initializing project templates and configurations.

methods.name: handle_get_run_command
methods.description: Function to retrieve and output the run command for a specified project type, formatted as JSON.

methods.name: create_minimal_project_config
methods.description: Function to create a minimal configuration dictionary for a given project type.
